description: Pre-initialize Wasm linear memory at build time so cold start is just mmap + jump

attempts.reason: Composed binary imports WASI + component-model interfaces; Wizer operates on core modules, not components. The fix is to Wizer the inventory core module BEFORE wrapping it as a component.

inventory.wasm is a component (not a core module). Wizer must be run on the core module at rust-inventory/target/wasm32-wasip1/release/deps/rust_inventory.wasm, then wrapped back to a component with wasm-tools component new --adapt wasi_snapshot_preview1=...

actualImplementation.step1: rust-inventory/src/lib.rs exports #[export_name = "wizer.initialize"] pub extern "C" fn wizer_init()
